title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
authors: Alexey Dosovitskiy, Lucas Beyer, Alexander Kolesnikov
abstract: We present Vision Transformer (ViT), which applies a pure transformer directly to image patches for image classification. Without CNN layers, the model achieves strong performance on large image datasets.

title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
authors: Ze Liu, Yutong Lin, Yue Cao
abstract: This work proposes Swin Transformer, a hierarchical transformer whose representation is computed with shifted windows. It serves as a general backbone for detection and segmentation.

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
authors: Kaiming He, Xinlei Chen, Saining Xie
abstract: Masked autoencoder (MAE) pre-trains vision models by reconstructing masked image patches. It learns powerful visual representations efficiently.

title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
authors: Maxime Oquab, Timothée Darcet, Théo Moutakanni
abstract: DINOv2 learns general-purpose visual features via self-supervision. The pre-trained model transfers well to many downstream vision tasks.

title: Segment Anything
authors: Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi
abstract: We introduce Segment Anything Model (SAM), a foundation model for image segmentation. It can generate masks for any object from prompts.

title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
authors: Shilong Liu, Tianhe Ren, Shuaibo Li
abstract: Grounding DINO performs open-set object detection with language grounding, linking object boxes to text labels.

title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
authors: Junnan Li, Dongxu Li, Silvio Savarese
abstract: BLIP-2 bridges pre-trained image encoders and LLMs via a Q-Former for vision-language tasks.

title: LLaVA: Large Language and Vision Assistant
authors: Haotian Liu, Chunyuan Li, Qingyang Wu
abstract: LLaVA aligns visual features and language models to create a multi-modal assistant for image understanding.

title: Depth Anything: Unleashing the Power of Large-Scale Unlabeled Data
authors: Lihe Yang, Bingyi Kang, Zilong Huang
abstract: Depth Anything builds a strong monocular depth estimator using massive unlabeled images, achieving robust 3D perception.

title: Deformable DETR: Deformable Transformers for End-to-End Object Detection
authors: Xizhou Zhu, Weijie Su, Lewei Lu
abstract: Deformable DETR uses deformable attention to accelerate transformer-based object detection.

title: MoCo: Momentum Contrast for Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning
authors: Kaiming He, Haoqi Fan, Yuxin Wu
abstract: Momentum Contrast (MoCo) builds a large queue of negative samples for contrastive self-supervised representation learning.

title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
authors: Ben Mildenhall, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Matthew Tancik
abstract: NeRF uses neural networks to model radiance fields for novel view synthesis of 3D scenes.

title: PointNet: Deep Learning on Point Sets for 3D Classification and Segmentation
authors: Charles R. Qi, Hao Su, Kaichun Mo
abstract: PointNet directly consumes point clouds for 3D classification and segmentation without voxelization.

title: CLIP: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training
authors: Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Chris Hallacy
abstract: CLIP learns image-text joint representation by contrastive pre-training on millions of image-text pairs.

title: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
authors: Shaoqing Ren, Kaiming He, Ross Girshick
abstract: Faster R-CNN introduces region proposal networks to generate candidate boxes for object detection.

title: RetinaNet: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
authors: Tsung-Yi Lin, Priya Goyal, Ross Girshick
abstract: RetinaNet uses focal loss to handle extreme foreground-background imbalance in dense object detection.

title: OneFormer: One Transformer to Rule Universal Image Segmentation
authors: Jitesh Jain, Anukriti Verma, Haotian Tang
abstract: OneFormer unifies semantic, instance and panoptic segmentation tasks within one transformer model.

title: XDecoder: A Unified Architecture for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation and Detection
authors: Xin Wang, Jifeng Dai, Yu Xiong
abstract: XDecoder performs open vocabulary segmentation and detection grounded by language prompts.

title: Segmenter: Transformer for Semantic Image Segmentation
authors: Robin Strudel, Ricardo Garcia, Ivan Laptev
abstract: Segmenter directly uses transformer architecture to predict segmentation masks from image patches.

title: SAM 2: Segment Anything in Images and Videos
authors: Nikhila Ravi, Valentin Gabeur, Yuan-Ting Hu
abstract: SAM2 extends Segment Anything to video, enabling promptable segmentation across image and video frames.

title: RAFT: Recurrent All-Pairs Field Transforms for Optical Flow
authors: Zachary Teed, Jia Deng
abstract: RAFT computes optical flow with recurrent all-pairs correlation for video motion estimation.

title: InternVL: A Strong Open-Source Vision-Language Foundation Model
authors: Zhaoyang Li, Yinan He, Yi Wang
abstract: InternVL is an open multimodal foundation model combining large vision encoder and language decoder.

title: MaskDINO: End-to-End Mask Transformer for Panoptic Segmentation
authors: Feng Li, Hao Zhang, Shilong Liu
abstract: MaskDINO is an end-to-end transformer model for panoptic segmentation using mask queries.

title: Video Understanding with Hierarchical Transformer
authors: Xunlong Wu, Bo Wang, Limin Wang
abstract: Hierarchical transformer captures long-range temporal dependencies for video representation and recognition.
